system.story: The break-in - the machine-tongue in his head speaking the node open.

effect.after:
Main action, ranged; no Bandwidth cost. Make a Cognition Power Roll (2d10 + Cognition + Hacking edge - 2d10+7 at Tier 5) to breach a node. Outcome Tier 1 (17+): compromise clean - no Alert raised (the Alert track may even drop a step), +2 Bandwidth (breach momentum), and a free Command against the node. Tier 2 (12-16): you are in, but the Alert track ticks up. Tier 3 (11 or less): you fail - Alert spikes and/or ICE bites (biofeedback).

Enhance - Spend 1 Bandwidth: breach a second linked node, or breach at an edge against a higher-Rating node.
